design: Targeted rapid measurement/provenance review, not a systematic review.
protocolTiming: Adaptive queries consolidated after orientation; no preregistration claimed.
reviewerRole: Maintaining agent; no independent duplicate extraction.
retrievalSystem: Web system1; primary publisher, PubMed/PMC, official agency and provider documents, public publisher PDF.
languageAndDates: English queries/content; no lower date limit except recorded recency filters. Publication metadata checked separately.
inclusion: Sources that distinguish the quantities, methods and reporting windows behind the 12 assigned claims. Original methodological aggregate analyses explicitly labelled.
exclusion: No participant data, authenticated API payloads, secondary effect estimates, clinical recommendation or production integration.
